import_image2d_from_png: use trade.ImporterManager to load a PNG file and access the image2d pixel data and format
load_mesh_from_gltf: use trade.ImporterManager to load a glTF file and access mesh vertex attributes and indices
load_scene_from_gltf: use trade.ImporterManager to load a glTF scene and access field data like translations and transformations
convert_image_format: use trade.ImageConverterManager to resize or convert an image to a different format or file
export_mesh_to_file: use trade.SceneConverterManager to convert and export a mesh to PLY or glTF file format
